title: Focaccia
heading: Method
body: Overnight focaccia. 500 g strong flour, 400 g water, 10 g salt, 4 g yeast, plenty of olive oil. Cold ferment 18 hours, rest 45 minutes in the tin, dimple, top with rosemary and flaky salt, bake at 230 degrees for 22 minutes. March 2026 bake: best yet, keep the long rise.

title: Red lentil soup
heading: Recipe
body: Onion, carrot, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, 250 g red lentils, 1.2 litres stock. Simmer 25 minutes, blend half, squeeze of lemon. Six portions; freezes for three months.

title: Kimchi
heading: Ratios
body: One napa cabbage, 2 percent salt by weight for the brine, gochugaru, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, spring onions. Ferment two days on the counter, then the fridge. Taste from day five.

title: Overnight oats
heading: Base mix
body: 50 g oats, 125 ml oat milk, a spoon of yoghurt, grated apple, cinnamon. Keeps four days.

title: Knee rehab plan
heading: Exercises from Oskar
body: Step-downs 3 x 12, wall sits 3 x 40 seconds, glute bridges 3 x 15. No running downhill until April. Ice 10 to 15 minutes after rides over an hour. Review with Oskar on 18 March at 8:15.

title: Sleep notes
heading: What helps
body: Journaling for ten minutes before bed helps more than reading did. No screens after 10pm. Bedroom cool, window open a crack.

title: Lowmoor flood model
heading: Status
body: Calibrating against the 2019 and 2023 flood events. Rainfall from six gauges; the Ashby gauge is missing most of November 2023. Next: sensitivity sweeps on Manning's n, channel and floodplain separately, slide for Priya by Thursday.

title: Westmere conference talk
heading: Plan
body: Twenty minutes on the Lowmoor model, about twelve slides. Abstracts due 31 March; talk on 12 June. Open with Felix's drone photo of the 2023 flood at Lowmoor bridge. Draft opening: the Lowmoor catchment flooded twice in nine days. Rehearse with Jonah.

title: Marrow Creek offer
heading: Pros and cons
body: Senior hydrologist, catchment planning. About 15 percent more pay, hybrid with three office days, forty minutes by bike against fifteen now. Answer due Friday 13 March; start Monday 6 April. Conference talks allowed if Tidewater is credited. Against: leaving the Lowmoor team.

title: Field kit checklist
heading: Survey kit
body: Waders (left seam patched), GPS, sediment corer and liners, sample bags, cool box, notebook, pencils, tide table, first aid kit, permits on display in the van.

title: Team contacts
heading: People

title: Wetlands field guide
heading: Plan
body: A pocket guide to the Harlow Bay wetlands: about sixty species across reedbed, saltmarsh, birds and insects. Plain language, one page each, with a confusion species and a field tip. Thirty entries drafted in March.

title: Varrow trip
heading: Plan
body: 8 to 14 August with Jonah. Overnight ferry from Fenwick pier out, Friday afternoon sailing back. Stay at the Net Loft in Merrow village. Calder lighthouse tour Monday, Hollow Bay boat trip Tuesday, Skerrin Point seals Wednesday. Book everything in April.

title: Ferry notes
heading: Fenwick sailings
body: Overnight sailing 21:30 from Fenwick, arriving 06:40. Day sailing 07:30. Window cabins about 40 pounds more than inside ones. Booking opens in April.

heading: About

heading: About

heading: About

title: Heat pump
heading: Savings

heading: Corvid

title: Energy supplier
heading: Switch
body: Switched from Coastline Energy to Brightgrid on 14 March 2026. Fixed tariff about 9 percent cheaper; 60 pound exit fee in the first year. Heat pump night tariff available.

title: Allotment plan
heading: Plot 14
body: Plot 14 from 1 April. Broad beans in March, first early potatoes late March, onion sets, carrots every three weeks from April, beetroot, runner beans and courgettes started indoors. Salad and chard from April. Compost bin in the shady corner, one water butt.

heading: Finished

heading: Second Tuesday Readers

heading: Sessions

title: Packing basics
heading: Always pack
